summary: IperionX Ltd filed a press release on Form 6-K announcing the results of a Definitive Feasibility Study for its Titan Critical Minerals Project in Tennessee. The DFS reports an after-tax NPV8 of $813M, 39% IRR, $1.9B after-tax free cash flow from a 14-year mine plan producing rare earths, titanium, and zircon. No merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special situation is described. The filing is a routine project update with no corporate transaction or event triggering a special-situations classification.
